rationale: The prior plan structure is sound. This revision addresses all three evaluation failures: (1) Adding 'provider_specialty' and 'network_status' as separate group_by dimensions ensures the group_comparison metric produces distinct groups for each dimension, resolving the missing groups_specialty and groups_network_status checks. (2) Changing the denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' aligns denial-rate computation with statistical discipline and the portfolio description. (3) Setting min_group_size to 30 enables proper small-group flagging. These changes preserve the complete analysis intent while fixing the specific metric calculation errors that caused evaluation failure.
changes_summary: Fixed group_comparison parameters: (1) expanded group_by to include separate 'provider_specialty', 'network_status', and combined 'provider_specialty+network_status' dimensions instead of only the combined dimension, (2) changed denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' for correct denial-rate computation, (3) set min_group_size from 0 to 30 for small-group flagging. These changes directly address the three evaluation failures while preserving all required artifacts and the overall analysis strategy.
